name: io.github.nikicat/mcp-wallet-signer
title: EVM Wallet Signer
description: Non-custodial MCP server that routes EVM transactions to browser wallets (MetaMask, Rabby, …) for signing. Private keys never leave the browser — every transaction requires explicit user approval.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_MCP_DEFAULT_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Default EVM chain ID (default: 1 for Ethereum mainnet)
